text.en:
3768
OFFICIAL GAZETTE
the provisions of the Minimum Wage Law and providing
for all the stautory obligations and ordinary essential
services of a regular municipality and that the mother
municipality of Tuburan, after the segregation therefrom
of the barrios comprised in the municipality of Tabuelan,
can still maintain. creditably its municipal government,
meet all statutory obligations, and provide for ordinary
essential municipal services.
Done in the City of Manila, this 23rd day of Sep-
tember, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
fifty-three, and of the Independence of the Philippines,
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
•MARCIANO ROQUE
Acting Executive Secretary
